name: Lucia
description: Privacy-first Home Assistant agent platform with its dashboard and Wyoming voice server. Before installing, run `docker network create lucia` in the Unraid terminal, then install the Lucia PostgreSQL and Redis templates.

paths.name: Models
paths.description: Downloaded speech and wake-word models. The container runs as UID 1100.

variables.description: ASP.NET Core environment.

variables.description: Internal HTTP listener.

variables.name: Store provider
variables.description: Persistent store provider.

variables.name: Cache provider
variables.description: Cache provider.

variables.name: Deployment mode
variables.description: Standalone runs all bundled agents in this container.

variables.name: Configuration database
variables.description: Replace CHANGE_ME with the Lucia-PostgreSQL password.

variables.description: Replace CHANGE_ME with the Lucia-PostgreSQL password.
